title: Ed25519 sign operation: an approved sign op that never returns the private key (DEC-262 item 2)
description: DEC-262 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1670, operator answer dec-1sowcwe A) routes item (2) to ward-cli as a new task: an Ed25519 sign operation, so an agent names a credential and an approved operation and Ward signs without returning the private key. Carrier for opum-doc ODOC-569. The record governs: read DEC-262 outcome by ref (opum-doc origin/dev, .quest/planning.json) once #1670 lands before building. Design questions DEC-262 does not settle go to opum-agent as an A/B, not decided here. Touches the credentials path class (DEC-182 (1)): stop and report before the first implementation commit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DEC-262 outcome is read by ref from opum-doc and this task cites it before any implementation
An approved sign operation signs caller-supplied bytes with a stored Ed25519 key and returns only the signature and public key, never the private key
The component ADR is recorded under this task, names DEC-262, and is checked by lore check

plan: 1. SecretRecord optional kind=ed25519; reader/serializer; vault without sign keys byte-identical (done, #285)
2. src/domain/signing.ts: generate, public key, sign, domain-prefix check (node:crypto) (done, #285)
3. Refuse kind records in run env, HTTPS header path, secret set/grant; exclude from backup, name excluded aliases in backup output (done, #285)
5. Tests (synthetic keys, temp store); ADR 0027 plus pointer amendments to 0003 and 0023 (done, #285)
6. Slice 2, after #285 merges: sign profile snapshot with its own version line (DEC-262 a4), ward sign, stdoutBytes, audit via existing AuditRecord, empty prefixes refused (a5), skill sentence
implementationNotes: DEC-183 review round 1 on #285 at 03104ac (opus, REQUEST CHANGES, 4 blockers). Mutation proofs, bun 1.3.14, test/signing.test.ts: (1) withoutSignKeys returns the state unchanged with excluded [] -> RED: "withoutSignKeys drops sign keys and names them" and the backup test (excludedSignKeys, text, container, restore and key-public assertions share one test); GREEN: signing domain, RFC 8032 vector, vault-document round trip and refusal tests. The reviewer predicted the domain unit test green; it goes red because it tests the function directly. (2) delete the re-serialize branch in runBackup but keep the report -> first run GREEN (not predicted): restore now filters by kind (N6), so the restored-aliases and key-public assertions could not see a seed left in the container. Added an assertion that opens the container with its passphrase and reads its state; mutation 2 then goes RED on the backup test only. Later: DEC-262 (a5) rules the empty sign-prefix list refused, and (a4) the per-kind snapshot versions.

DEC-262 (a6) (opum-doc#1677): the container stays unchanged and excluded sign keys are named at backup time, in text and --json. Restore states in prose that sign keys are never carried and must be regenerated and re-enrolled, and does not claim to name them; this replaces (a3) (ii) "restore names each excluded alias". Implemented and tested on #285. DEC-262 (a7) (opum-doc#1679): HTTP snapshot version stays at its current 3 (a4 said 2); an audit failure after a signature exists makes ward sign exit nonzero and name the failure on stderr (slice 2); status and doctor reporting of sign keys stays out, no follow-up.

Round 2 on #285 (opus, one ADR clause plus notes). The round-1 mutation proofs above are in this task implementationNotes since commit 6d17a9d. Mutation 3, bun 1.3.14: remove the restore-by-kind filter (runRestore secrets: backup.secrets) -> RED only on the new test "a container that holds one still restores to nothing", which seals a state carrying a sign key with sealBackup and restores it; the other 14 signing tests stay green. Also fixed: ADR clause on check vs run, sign_input_refused asserted by code, secret state sign-key asserted in profile list, guidance reworded.

DEC-183 review of #285 and its landing under DEC-265 (opum-doc#1681, deed578). Round 1 at 03104ac: REQUEST CHANGES (4 blockers). Round 2 at 8d67ca9, Opus ward-cli-review-285b: REQUEST CHANGES (one ADR clause). Round 3 (4q) at 5249ae0, Opus ward-cli-review-285c (model verified claude-opus-5-5): REQUEST CHANGES on one ADR clause (profile list is exit 0, not exit 6). The fix at 7575d22 was accepted by the leader by-ref verification under DEC-265 with no fourth review: the diff from 5249ae0 is confined to the ADR 0027 sentence and the profiles.ts guidance string, the sentence matches profiles.ts, and Check, Docs and Tracker integrity are green on that head. No --human-reviewer was passed. Slice 2 (sign profile, ward sign) follows in its own PR from dev.
